capacity:log-readers.title: Kafka readers can't keep up
capacity:log-readers.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 3/s (200%): its backlog only grows. Assigned instances: 3 / 8 · Partitions.
capacity:log-readers.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

fix.label: Set replicas to 11 and Order log: Partitions → 11
